score_mnist_dataframe: compute a single score combining regret and final accuracy from an MNIST experiment dataframe
plot_learning_regret: plot the average regret through time for MNIST experiment data with a baseline dashed line
plot_seeds_accuracy: plot per-run accuracy over time for MNIST experiment data colored by a variable
review_score_function: review the score function that combines 50 percent regret and 50 percent final accuracy
summarize_plot_seeds: summarize the plot_seeds function that computes average accuracy from total regret and episode data
